selectedFoundation: B: one Capture Import action; anchored Image or PDF / Markdown choice; file beside optional clarification, stacked on narrow screens.

backendEvidence.verification: Backend completion, independent verification and clean rebase reported by the parent; not rerun by this design task.

boundary: Browser → Next.js server → Hono. Next attaches user credentials server-side. No browser-visible private paths, daemon credentials, native IDs or raw internal inputs. The daemon/OpenCode share a filesystem; no attachment transport or media worker UI is introduced.
identities: Media endpoints use thought.mediaSource.id. Ordinary Idea/children/title/Evolve/rejection endpoints use thought.id. Run reads and Stop use run.id. These are distinct daemon-owned identities; upload and retry keys are frozen command identities, not source IDs.

apiMapping.input: one file and metadata containing only optional exact clarification; frozen upload key
apiMapping.success: 202 or exact replay 200 confirms retained source and original weave admission, not interpretation

apiMapping.policy: read only, original upload key; 404 does not rule out a delayed request; the returned run is the original weave, never a later retry
same original bytes/name/clarification/key, explicitly labelled as a write; never a new key or automatic duplicate submission

apiMapping.intent: Open source or Check current processing
apiMapping.policy: thought plus latest non-title source run, nullable, and fresh-retry advisory; never infer absent agent configuration from queued

apiMapping.intent: Observe or stop a known run
apiMapping.policy: known identity only; Stop preserves saved work and does not guarantee native cancellation has settled

apiMapping.intent: Read recorded interpretation or Full reply
apiMapping.policy: render only canonically read output; completed status alone is not an interpretation or readable reply
deliberate fresh retry with a new retry key only when current advisory permits and no unresolved local retry attempt exists; server rechecks eligibility and may refuse with 409; no reupload
observe current source/run/eligibility; do not claim a newly observed run proves which request admitted it; old unconfirmed intent remains frozen

apiMapping.endpoint: POST /media-sources/:id/retry {} with the original retry key
apiMapping.policy: explicit write, not Check: may admit work if the first request never arrived, otherwise exact replay; never silently replace the key
normal scope unless user explicitly entered history; exact verified bytes, fixed safe attachment name; no inline PDF renderer or substitute content

apiMapping.endpoint: GET /media-sources/:id?scope=history plus existing user-scoped Idea/context reads
apiMapping.policy: explicit user inspection only; worded rejection and disabled Evolve; no automatic scope broadening; history download remains separate from restore

apiMapping.intent: Edit/clear title, Evolve, reject/restore, search and export
apiMapping.policy: immutable file and clarification; title clear requests title-only generation; Evolve creates a new contribution; rejection retains files and uses existing branch scopes; Search/Agentic Export read descriptors and recorded text, never original bytes

stateActionMatrix.guard: selection alone sends nothing; Markdown remains its existing separate workflow
frozen copyable snapshot, duplicate admission disabled; no claimed source acceptance or interpretation progress
400/401/403/413/415/422 or receiver-busy only when boundary establishes no admission; retain clarification; do not invent a specific validation cause
retain original key/file/clarification; a read error is not a failed upload; unexpected storage/server failures are conservative unknown
404 is not proof a delayed upload cannot arrive; explicit same-key resend is a write and may admit the source
no fresh retry; no invented configuration cause, ETA, progress percentage or streamed native text
advisory eligible true, authoritative admission can still refuse; original retained
no retry button until fresh advisory permits; do not say work fully stopped
no second initial interpretation even after rejection; saved output remains even if run later fails/interrupted
not labelled Interpretation ready; no fresh retry
nullable run is not fabricated failure or activity; action follows retry advisory
Check is GET; resend is an explicit same-key POST and may start work; no new retry key while unresolved
refresh eligibility; never automatically replay or invent the exact conflicting cause
retain last-confirmed display with warning; disable new retry until a successful current read; never label the run failed from observation error
no assertion of rejection until history read establishes it
no Evolve or fresh retry; restoration does not restart earlier work; branch/individual and independently rejected children/connections remain distinct
no substitute bytes or deleted-file inference; retain source record

readingRules: Rejected content is unavailable to AI. Explicit user history may mix active and rejected records; never describe all inspected content as rejected or imply an exceptional AI-access path for rejected records.
A media root has null thought text. Present its descriptor and separately attributed exact clarification, or a plain absence label; never invent extracted text or a user-authored placeholder.
No title uses filename fallback on Idea, context rows, Evolve, search, Ask and Export root. File authorship remains unverified.
Media match text is its clarification; filename fallback, MIME and binary contents are not lexical body input. Explicit titles and recorded interpretations/replies remain searchable.

Keep the existing compact Explore layout and add Images and PDFs to material facets; Imported source is the existing source-authorship label. Rename the existing Markdown-kind label to Imported Markdown to distinguish kinds without changing stored values.

The AI child and Full reply are separate records. Relationships use actual parent/source IDs, deduplicate context as incumbent, and never invent a source relationship solely because a file appears nearby.

Known source Idea links are bookmarkable. Unknown upload/retry snapshots and unsent files live only in mounted client memory; no recent-media list, reload persistence, autosave or background browser upload promise.

A refusal of a recovery resend does not disprove an earlier unknown admission. Keep its frozen intent/key until a canonical receipt or explicit current-state resolution; never turn a later 401/413/refusal into proof that the earlier attempt did not save.

Upstream atmosphere remains scoped: the approved desktop Capture canopy appears only on Capture and is omitted on phone; Explore clearing is initial-only, not results; the 2.4-second root arrival runs only on explicit root visits, never these deep-linked media surfaces. No new art or animation is introduced.
responsiveAccessibility: Use incumbent font/tokens, visible 3px blue focus and underlined text actions. Keep labels, worded status/errors and normal source/You/AI attribution independent of color.

B columns and Idea context rows stack below 48rem. Evolve retains its rail/disclosure and same-row textarea/Send. Narrow controls stay at least 44px high, with full-width primary actions where incumbent.

Readonly uncertain snapshots remain copyable. Repeated writes are synchronously guarded and disabled while pending. Status updates announce changes without stealing reading focus or scrolling the page.
Normal/history navigation is explicit. Disclosures keep expanded state and Escape/focus return. Existing rejection dialogs and stale branch preview rules are inherited, not redesigned.
Allow long filename, MIME, IDs, clarification, interpretation and reply text to wrap. No literal scaling of PNGs into runtime UI.
implementationBoundary: The existing web decoders are text-only. The separate implementation must accept the media Thought/search/context/Ask-preview union, preserve null text and descriptor/clarification semantics, and keep all daemon credentials and managed file paths server-side. Design simulations and illustrative content are not test fixtures or implemented API behavior.
